path.description: File path relative to codebase root (e.g. 'project-docs/env.md'). Must end in .md.

content.description: File content, or the section body when `section` is set (max 8000 bytes in section mode).

section.description: Optional markdown heading line (e.g. '## Recent Changes (auto)'). Replaces that section in place, or appends it if absent. The rest of the document is never touched.

force.description: Whole-file mode only: bypass the incremental-update guard for an intentional full rewrite (default: false).
